terms.meaning: Searching source files for class names so only needed styles are created.
The set of default colours, fonts and sizes that Tailwind uses.

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Scan locations and defaults
sections.what: Lists the files Tailwind searches for class names and leaves the theme at its defaults.
sections.why: Likely reason: the standard setup for a Vite project.
sections.watch_out: New folders outside src need to be added here or their styles disappear.

summary: Tells Tailwind which files to scan for style class names. No custom theme is set.
purpose: Controls which styles are included in the final stylesheet.
why: Likely reason: Tailwind includes only the classes it finds in the listed files, which keeps the stylesheet small.
how: Scans index.html and every JavaScript and TypeScript file under src, and uses Tailwind's default theme with no extra plugins.
outputs: The generated stylesheet used by index.css.
risks: Files outside the listed folders will have their styles left out.
debug: If styles are missing on a new file, confirm the file sits inside src or is listed here.
